Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need a decision on the account-scoped toggle behavior for enterprise customers before next week's deploy. Specifically: how do we want allowlists + contract gating + VIP overrides to interact?
Josh Patel: TL;DR: prefer explicit allowlist > contract gating > VIP override, with an audit log for any VIP bypass.
Ian Gomez: Agree with order, but we need an automated safety net: if allowlist is empty for an enrolled customer, default to disabled. Can't have accidental open access.
Grace Li: For enterprise contracts, legal requires that if a feature is in their SOW we auto-enable (contract gating). How do we represent that in the config?
Josh Patel: Suggestation: flag config has booleans and arrays, e.g.
```json
{
  "enabled": false,
  "allowlist": ["acct-1234", "acct-5678"],
  "contract_gated": ["acct-9999"],
  "vip_overrides": ["acct-5678"],
  "audit_on_override": true
}
```
Maria Chen: That looks fine. Two operational questions: 1) When we flip a flag on for contract_gated accounts, do we do a canary (5% of requests) first? 2) Who signs off on VIP overrides?
Ian Gomez: For canary, I propose customer-level canary window: enable for 1 customer (the contract account) for 1 hour, then increase to 10% traffic for that account, then full. For multi-account SOWs we do parallel canaries.
Grace Li: VIP overrides require product + account exec signoff. Add an email webhook to ops for manual approvals.
Josh Patel: Ops runbook item: if eviction or perf regression detected, auto-fallback to safe model and notify #incidents and account execs. Add a rollout TTL so overrides don't persist forever.
Maria Chen: Can someone drop the exact feature-flag semantics into the runbook and a short PR template for reviewers? Need to include tests for empty-allowlist behavior, contract gating precedence, and audit logs.
Ian Gomez: I'll put up a PR with unit tests and an integration harness against staging. Pinged in the description: @release-bot for canary gating automation.
release-bot: Noted. Please add the following labels to the PR: release/canary, needs-ops-approval. Canary automation will run after CI passes.
Grace Li: Also add a config sample for the console UI so support can toggle per-account safely (read-only audit trail).
Josh Patel: Quick code snippet for lookup order (psuedocode):
```python
def is_feature_enabled(account_id, flag):
    if account_id in flag.allowlist:
        return True
    if account_id in flag.contract_gated:
        return True
    if account_id in flag.vip_overrides and vip_approved(account_id):
        return True
    return False
```
Maria Chen: Great — thanks. Action items: Ian to create PR + tests, Grace to draft signoff flow and webhook, Josh to update ops runbook with TTL/fallback. I'll schedule a 15m async review on Monday. :thumbsup:
Ian Gomez: Will do, PR by EOD.
Grace Li: I'll drop the webhook spec into #eng-platform-docs today.
Maria Chen: Closing the loop here. If anyone needs to change the precedence we can call it out in the PR for discussion.
